---
title: "Quarto OS in slides"
subtitle: "Windows, live terminals and a desktop — in reveal.js"
format:
  revealjs:
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    slide-number: true
    transition: fade
    hash: true
    css: slides.css
    footer: "[Quarto OS](../index.html) · ← → to navigate · drag windows by their title bar"
quarto-os:
  vm:
    setup: |
      git config --global user.name "Presenter"
      git config --global user.email "presenter@example.com"
      git config --global core.pager cat
      mkdir -p ~/talk ~/demo
      cd ~/demo
      printf '# Demo\n\nA repository created live on stage.\n' > README.md
      printf 'print("Hello, audience!")\n' > hello.py
---

## Floating windows

Inside a slide, `float=true` windows are positioned with `x`/`y` on the slide and can be
**dragged around** during the talk.

::: {.os-window title="flow-field.jpg" float=true x=40 y=232 width=500 height=339}
![](assets/flow-field.jpg){fig-alt="Generative flow-field artwork"}
:::

::: {.os-window title="fib.py" float=true x=470 y=300 width=440 height=250 theme="dark"}
```python
def fib(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return a

print([fib(i) for i in range(10)])
```
:::

::: {.os-window title="note.md" float=true x=870 y=232 width=330 height=130}
**Try it:** grab a title bar and move me. Click a window to bring it to the front.
:::

## A real terminal

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="58%"}
::: {#t1 .os-window app="terminal" title="bash" height="470px" cwd="~/demo" theme="dark"}
:::
:::

::: {.column width="42%" .snippets}
Click to run:

- `ls -la`{.os-run target="t1"}
- `python3 hello.py`{.os-run target="t1"}
- `uname -m`{.os-run target="t1"}
- `date`{.os-run target="t1"}

```{.bash .os-run target="t1"}
for i in 3 2 1; do
  echo "$i…"; sleep 1
done; echo "Liftoff!"
```

A real Debian VM in the browser, booted when this slide was first shown.
:::

## Git, live

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="56%"}
::: {#g .os-window app="terminal" title="bash — ~/talk" height="380px" cwd="~/talk"}
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
::: {.os-window app="explorer" title="talk" path="~/talk" height="380px"}
:::
:::

::::

::: {.snippet-row}
`git init`{.os-run target="g"} → `echo "# Talk" > README.md; git add README.md`{.os-run target="g"} →
`git commit -m "First commit"`{.os-run target="g"} → `git log --oneline`{.os-run target="g"}
:::

Watch `.git` appear in the Explorer after `git init`.

## A desktop on a slide

::: {#slide-desk .os-desktop height="560px" title="Quarto OS" wallpaper="assets/wallpaper.svg"}

::: {.os-window title="About" x=40 y=40 width=380 height=200}
**A desktop in your deck.** The dock opens **new** terminals, editors and explorers —
as many as you want, all on one VM.
:::

::: {.os-window app="vscode" title="demo — VS Code" x=460 y=60 width=720 height=380 folder="~/demo" open="hello.py"}
:::

## Launch buttons

Each button opens a **new** floating window on *this* slide:

::: {.launch-row}
[Terminal]{.os-launch app="terminal" cwd="~/demo" x=60 y=250 width=560 height=320}
[VS Code]{.os-launch app="vscode" folder="~/demo" open="README.md" x=380 y=220 width=760 height=420}
[Explorer]{.os-launch app="explorer" path="~/demo" x=700 y=260 width=480 height=320}
:::

```markdown
[Terminal]{.os-launch app="terminal" cwd="~/demo"}
[VS Code]{.os-launch app="vscode" folder="~/demo" open="README.md"}
[Explorer]{.os-launch app="explorer" path="~/demo"}
```
